Portable Madgraph_step upstream source provenance

FeynRules 2.3.49 (29 September 2021)
Upstream: https://github.com/FeynRules/FeynRules
Commit: b3357d64ac3dfa3de97d7536dcff5ba92d04f086
Source: https://codeload.github.com/FeynRules/FeynRules/tar.gz/b3357d64ac3dfa3de97d7536dcff5ba92d04f086
Archive SHA256: 4810c2113f4c9019e4f4e427a73a96bcda72f6e92050a9221c05ff173abdbd99
License: FeynRules/LICENSE (GPL-3.0).
This distribution includes the FeynRules runtime and SM model used by the benchmark.
Ancillary upstream files are omitted. The checksum identifies the upstream archive.
Local Wolfram 15 compatibility changes qualify the public FeynRules MatrixSymbol
accessor and give its private field commutator a distinct name. The UFO writer
now records the incoming and outgoing fields of the first unclassified vertex
in unknown_vertex_fields.json and aborts before writing invalid Python.

MadGraph5_aMC@NLO 3.7.3 (1 September 2026)
Upstream: https://github.com/mg5amcnlo/mg5amcnlo
Tag: v3.7.3
Source: https://codeload.github.com/mg5amcnlo/mg5amcnlo/tar.gz/refs/tags/v3.7.3
Archive SHA256: cd143868efb4bdd044745407e05d0d134858c2e52233cbe5a27774300fad51eb
License: MG5_aMC/LICENSE; bundled vendor licenses retained in their directories.
Built-in PDF tables retained in Template/LO/lib/Pdfdata and Template/NLO/lib/Pdfdata.
This distribution includes the MadGraph source, templates and model data used
by the package. Upstream tests and ancillary files are omitted. The checksum
identifies the upstream archive. Project-specific input/mg5_configuration.txt
disables update checks, notifications, and automatic browser opening and selects
local execution. Runtime-generated files may appear after calculations.

offline_guard/sitecustomize.py is project-owned, not an upstream source file.
It blocks remote Python sockets when MADGRAPH_STEP_OFFLINE=1. The public runner
also uses only the bundled model/PDF paths and never calls MadGraph install.

Downloaded 10 November 2026. No conda, pip, or Mathematica package installation
was performed to obtain these source distributions.
